sections.sectionText: Meets with ME 598 (48380) and MSE 598 (70522). We introduce the connection of materials and data science, and specific issues regarding experimental and computational materials data. Topics include data acquisition and management, data curation, uncertainty quantification, and applying machine learning to materials data. The focus will be on current scientific literature in the emerging materials and data area.
